notes.title: Big Update: New Demo & Trailer Coming Sept 29
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]Since launching our demo, we’ve been hard at work addressing your feedback and adding new features to [i]She’s Leaving[/i]. Your support and input have been invaluable in helping us refine our debut title.[/p][p]We’ve temporarily taken the demo offline as we prepare to roll out an [b]enhanced version[/b] on [b]Monday, September 29th[/b] arriving alongside a [b]brand new trailer[/b] and some very exciting news we can’t wait for you to see.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who played the original demo and shared your thoughts. It’s made a huge difference in shaping the game.[/p][p][i]She’s Leaving[/i] is still on track for a [b]Fall 2025 release[/b], with more details revealed soon.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and we’ll see you Monday![/p]
